title: Vanish
description: A single text field on warm white. Type a line and press Enter: the words let go from left to right, each letter leaning off the rule as a sheared ghost of itself, tops first and feet last, before a curl of air takes its pixels apart into specks that thin as they rise, until the field is empty again and the caret and placeholder come back. Keep typing while it happens; the field is never locked.
intent: After Rauno Freiberg's Vanish input (https://rauno.me/craft/vanish-input): submitting a prompt dissolves its own glyph pixels like ink into air and resets the field for the next one, interruptible, real <input>, canvas only for the vanish.
